segments.summary: Reviewed every prologue/core line across the legacy invariant body; exact contracts are broad, while executable enforcement is explicitly partial.
Reviewed the service-bound workbench continuation plus AI-001 through AI-004; correlation and route invalid-state handling remain unspecified.
Reviewed AI-005 through AI-011; event, UI, ordering, persistence, and ID boundaries are explicit, while secret failure/enforcement oracles are absent.
Reviewed AI-012 through AI-018; authority and wiring boundaries are strong, while concurrency equivalence and proof requirements remain ambiguous.
Reviewed AI-019 through AI-025; accounting, file integrity, UI mapping, and codegen contracts are explicit, while numeric edge rules and gate executability remain incomplete.
Reviewed AI-026 through AI-032; debug and runtime identity semantics are explicit, while compound recovery transitions lack executable oracles.
Reviewed AI-033 through AI-038; route and visibility contracts are explicit, while governance enforcement and stale consumer reconciliation remain open risks.
